summary: Iteration 145 - Commerce Center V1 Testing Complete. All core features verified: /commerce-center route loads without blank screen, GET /api/commerce-center/overview returns stats + flash sales + marketplace + penny auctions without serialization errors, Flash Sale purchase via POST /api/commerce-center/flash-sales/{sale_id}/buy works with wallet deduction and overview refresh. CTA navigations to /marketplace, /auctions, /live-auctions, /live work correctly. Navigation entry points exist in MorePage and AllServicesPage (require auth).

issues: Cookie banner overlays bottom of page but does not block functionality
